lines.text:
If you catch a bunch of the same Pokémon
species, the chance of you finding an item
after catching them increases!\c
I go for Geodude and Onix, myself.
Bahaha!

There are ways you can get special bonuses
when you catch a Pokémon!\c
Number one! Time your throw to land when
the ring is small!\c
Number two! Catch them with your first throw...
And so on!\c
You’ll get a lot of good things out of it, such as
extra Exp. Points.

If you catch the same Pokémon species over
and over, you’ll get a Catch Combo.\c
If you can keep it going, I hear you’ll be more
likely to run into Shiny Pokémon!
You’re more likely to find an item after catching\na Pokémon if you feed it a Pinap Berry first,\r\nright? You’ve noticed that, too, right?
